parameters.content:
## 📊 OpenClaw Cron Intelligence Report

**What this workflow does:**
Runs daily at 8am. Gathers key business metrics from multiple sources (GitHub, Slack activity, server health, support tickets), asks Claude to synthesize them into an executive intelligence report, and delivers it via OpenClaw to your preferred channel (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, etc.).

**Setup steps:**
1. Add Claude API credentials
2. Configure your data sources in the `Data Sources` node
   - GitHub repo stats (optional)
   - Custom API endpoints
3. Set your OpenClaw delivery channel in the `Delivery Config` node
4. Add any API credentials needed for your data sources
5. Activate — runs daily at 8am local time

**Customize:** Add/remove data sources in the Code node. The more context you give Claude, the better the report.

## 📡 Add Your Data Sources Here

Between `Delivery Config` and `Gather Metrics`, add HTTP nodes to pull real data:

1. **GitHub commits:** `GET https://api.github.com/repos/yourorg/repo/commits`
2. **Stripe revenue:** `GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges` (with API key)
3. **Server uptime:** `GET https://your-status-page/api`
4. **Freshdesk tickets:** `GET https://yoursite.freshdesk.com/api/v2/tickets`

Then merge results in the `Gather Metrics` Code node.
